messages:
Max: Heads up — noticed p95 regressions on route=chat-stream after yesterday's kernel-affinity change. Metric jump ~120ms -> 340ms. flame graph: https://perf/internal/trace/abcd
Anya: looking... KV-cache hitrate dropped from 0.82 -> 0.65 around the same time. median tokens/batch shifted 14 -> 9
Phil: that matches. kernel affinity change is forcing smaller microbatches on Ampere. Propose dynamic token budgets per route/tier and a small queue hold bump
Phil: example config idea:
```json
{"batcher": {"routes": {"chat-stream": {"token_budget_p95": 48, "min_microbatch_tokens": 16}, "search-embed": {"token_budget_p95": 128}}}}
```
Sophia: can we canary? prefer ramp by tier: free -> dev -> default -> enterprise. also want observability hooks (per-route p95, kv-hit, microbatch dist)
Max: Canary scope suggestion: route=chat-stream tier=default -> token_budget=40, kernel_hint=auto, queue_hold_ms=6
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: hosts=8, start_ts=1748801300
Anya: quick profiler on one canary host — kernel switch churn up ~3x, KV miss penalty measurable (~7ms/token on miss). traces attached: https://perf/internal/trace/ef01
Phil: maybe prefer KV-friendly kernel for chat-stream even if single-token throughput slightly worse. The tail cost on misses is killing p95
Sophia: also try increasing queue_hold_ms for default tier from 2 -> 6 to let microbatches form without hurting median too much
Max: ran a short spike test with canary + queue tweak: canary p95 dropped to ~180ms, KV hit restored to 0.78, no error spike
observability-bot: Alert summary: SLO breaches in control group -> 18%, canary group -> 6% over last 10m (reduction 12%)
Sophia: ok, ramp plan: 20% hosts for 1h then 50% if stable. rollout notes: https://wiki/internal/batcher/rollouts
Anya: note for follow-up: regression traces show kernel_v2 gives better cold-head latency but worse tail when KV miss. Suggest scoring kernel choices by (expected_latency + miss_risk * penalty) instead of raw throughput
Phil: will prototype a scoring function and a tiny simulator to sweep token_budget_by_route/tier. putting task on board: BATCH-314
Max: next steps: Phil prototype, Anya run wider perf profiling across hw, Sophia manage canary ramp + alerts. Ping when prototype + 1h canary done :thumbsup:
Sophia: pinging @Phil to sync 10:00 tomorrow for prototype walkthrough
deploy-bot: Canary update: hosts=20 (20%), health=ok, p95_canary=172ms, errors=0
Max: thanks all — keeping thread open but marking current phase as "monitoring". Will reopen if we see rollback criteria met :ok_hand:
